Count cells in a cr_experiment

Source: R/utilities.R
cr_n_cells.Rd

Count cells in a cr_experiment

Usage

cr_n_cells(experiment, by = NULL)

Arguments

experiment

A cr_experiment.

by

Optional character vector of grouping columns from the design or cells table. If NULL, returns total count.

Value

Either a scalar integer (no grouping) or a tibble with cell counts per group.

Examples

exp <- cr_example_experiment(seed = 1, n_cells_per_well = 10)
cr_n_cells(exp)
#> [1] 1068
cr_n_cells(exp, by = "treatment")
#> # A tibble: 6 × 2
#>   treatment       n_cells
#>   <chr>             <int>
#> 1 CompoundA_ScavX     182
#> 2 CompoundA_ScavY     173
#> 3 CompoundA_high      169
#> 4 CompoundA_low       181
#> 5 PosControl          175
#> 6 Untreated           188
